intro_zh: 《道德经》相传为春秋时期老子所著，共八十一章，分「道经」与「德经」两部分。它以极简的文字谈论宇宙的本源、万物的秩序与人生的修养。本系列逐章细读原文，并与圣经相关经文对照阅读，看东西方经典如何回应同样的问题。
intro_en: Traditionally attributed to Laozi, the Tao Te Ching has 81 short chapters on the origin of all things, the order of nature and the cultivation of life. This series reads it chapter by chapter alongside related passages of the Bible, asking how East and West answer the same questions.
